status: selected candidate policy; tests and successor freeze required
question: Can a larger finite call ceiling plus explicit in-budget finalization prevent administrative truncation from hiding the selected evidence comparison?

selection.total_model_token_cap: unchanged per frozen cell; primary tier 96000
selection.switch_rule: Before exploration dispatch, measure the exact request. Switch to tools-disabled finalization if the request plus reserved finalization capacity would exceed the cumulative token cap, or only two calls remain. The switch itself dispatches no model request.
selection.finalization_rule: Preserve pending tool delivery and ordinary arm-specific index; request an honest final selection, allowing empty context without score credit. At most the existing one bounded correction opportunity; every dispatched finalization call consumes the original total-token and call caps.
selection.unknown_usage: blocks all further model requests, never treated as zero
selection.context_no_fit: explicit context_budget_stopped; no dropped pending tool evidence
selection.transport: separately named contextbench-budget-v1, maximum 96 requests; existing transport profiles retain their old limits

alternatives.reason: Six completed cells stopped at the call ceiling; that ceiling can mask useful continuation below the selected token cap.
Would retain the observed no-final-output cliff at the token boundary.

alternatives.choice: unbounded calls or extra post-budget final response
alternatives.reason: Violates finite preregistration or cumulative token accounting.

risks: Reserving up to two context-admissible responses may reduce useful exploration and leave tokens unused.
A 96-call safety bound can still bind; report it explicitly rather than claiming the token cap was the sole stopping constraint.
Tools-disabled finalization can only select genuinely delivered evidence; it cannot repair missing evidence through a free read.
The next matched H1 comparison cannot isolate causal effects of each common instrument repair or prove H6 independently.
criteria: No provider request during phase switch.
Finalization prompt has no tools but retains pending source delivery.
Actual input/output usage including correction stays within original admission policy.
Unknown usage, insufficient finalization budget and context no-fit cannot bypass admission.
No extra call after maximum_calls; legacy transport profiles keep their former caps.
